// PRESERVED, NOT FIXED (see objc.go's stateDecToImp doc): a C++-style
// "const"-qualified free function written in a .m/.mm file drives
// ObjCStates' overridden _state_dec_to_imp into restarting a bogus new
// function on the "const" token itself, discarding the real "realFn"
// declaration entirely -- kept isolated in its own file so this quirk's
// effect on the count is provable without touching any other fixture's
// coverage.
int realFn(int a) const {
    return a;
}
